plugin.name: I understand - I have OSF Animation, OSFUI, and SFSE installed
plugin.description:
OSF Autonomous requires ALL of the following to function:
1. OSF Animation - Native Scene Framework - provides the OSF animation API (StartSceneByTags, callbacks, etc.) 2. OSFUI - provides the settings system this mod reads ALL its configuration from. Without OSFUI.pex, the script will not load. 3. SFSE - required by both OSF Animation and OSFUI
Please install these before enabling this mod. Without them, no scenes will play and the quest will fail to start.
Note: If you use Mod Organizer 2, the installer cannot detect OSF plugins through MO2's virtual file system. This check is informational only - it does not scan your installed mods.

group.name: Which animation pack(s) do you use? (Informational only - packs must be downloaded separately)

plugin.name: GE Animation Pack
plugin.description: Recommended. 388+ MF scenes with furniture support. The mod prioritizes GE scenes when available. Without GE, furniture-anchored scenes will not play.

plugin.name: SnuSnu Field
plugin.description: Femdom-oriented scenes with strapon support. The mod automatically uses correct role ordering for SnuSnu scenes. Adds native FF content.

plugin.name: Other / Custom pack
plugin.description: The mod works with ANY OSF animation pack via catch-all fallback tiers. Your pack's scenes will be found automatically as long as they use standard OSF tags (paired, mf/ff, action tags). You will have fewer scene varieties without GE or SnuSnu.
